title: Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
qualification: Master's degree in Soil & Water Engg. / Masters in Horticulture with 4 years of bachelor's degree having first division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average. Candidates with 3 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience.
age_limit: Maximum 35 for Male candidate, 40 for Female candidate
